title: Orecchiette with tomato sauce

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Lycopene
healthBenefits.text: Tomato puree provides lycopene, an antioxidant linked to reduced risk of heart disease and certain cancers.

healthBenefits.title: Sustained Energy
healthBenefits.text: Orecchiette pasta offers complex carbohydrates that provide steady, long-lasting energy.

healthBenefits.title: Bone Health
healthBenefits.text: Pecorino cheese is a good source of calcium and phosphorus, supporting strong bones and teeth.

healthBenefits.title: Cardiovascular Support
healthBenefits.text: Onions contain flavonoids like quercetin that may help reduce inflammation and support heart health.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil is rich in monounsaturated fats and polyphenols that support cardiovascular health.

healthBenefits.title: Protein Source
healthBenefits.text: The combination of pasta and pecorino cheese contributes a moderate amount of protein to support muscle maintenance.

_ingredientsText:
400 gr of orecchiette pasta 
500 gr of tomato puree 
80 gr of pecorino cheese, grated
1 small onion, chopped
2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 
salt
_preparationText:
1 -fase di preparazione delle orecchiette
2 - orecchiette fresche pronte per la cottura
3 -bollitura delle orecchiette
